subject: SIG+CAIQ: Key management artifacts and HSM sampling plan for HearthBank
messages:
From: Lisa Monroe <security-assurance@hearthbank.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: HearthBank SOC <soc@hearthbank.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Jul 2029 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: SIG/CAIQ - Key management artifacts request

Hi Michael,

Thanks again for taking HearthBank through the SIG intake. As part of our encryption/keys review for CAIQ/SIG we need the following artifacts so we can complete the sample-based review:

- HSM shift/operation logs (sanitized) covering Q1 and Q2 2029 (operator IDs may be redacted).
- Current key rotation schedule and runbook (how KEKs/DEKs are rotated, frequency, and automation).
- Evidence of transport encryption in front-line services (TLS ciphers, TLS versions, and any mTLS notes).
- KEK wrap/unwrap manifest indicating wrapping key IDs used for tenant-byok operations (sample).

Preferred delivery: SFTP upload to an account we provide, or SharePoint link with expiring access. We also need checksums for each archive and a brief note describing any redactions applied so our reviewers can validate the sample integrity.

Can you confirm feasibility and an ETA? Our target for initial pass is EOD Tue 2029-07-16.

Regards,
Lisa Monroe
Information Assurance Lead, HearthBank
security-assurance@hearthbank.com

---
Note: this request is scoped to the SIG encryption sections only; do not include tenant PII or private customer data in the bundles.

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Monroe <security-assurance@hearthbank.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Jul 2029 10:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ - Key management artifacts request

Hi Lisa — thanks for the clear list. We can do this and will ship a sanitized package plus a short intake note describing redaction and sampling methodology. High-level plan:

1) HSM logs: we will extract operator shift logs for Q1–Q2 2029 and replace operator usernames with stable pseudonyms (operator-001, operator-002) so timing/sequence is preserved but identities are redacted.
2) Rotation schedule & runbook: provide the live schedule (CSV) plus the internal runbook excerpt that explains automated rotation jobs and manual override steps.
3) Transport encryption: generate a short PDF with our TLS cipher inventory for edge and internal ingress points and a packet-level note for anything requiring mTLS.
4) KEK manifest: provide a sampled CSV mapping wrapping key id -> wrapped key ids (no plaintext keys).

Delivery options: we prefer SFTP for large archives. We will create an expiring SFTP folder and provide an SSH key for your ingestion user. If you need SharePoint instead, we can grant time-limited access.

We will also produce SHA256 checksums and a short MD5 for compatibility. Expected ETA for the initial artifact bundle: 2029-07-14 by 17:00 PT for the sample set. Full index and any follow-ups by 2029-07-16 if you need deeper slices.

Two quick asks from our side:
- Please confirm the SFTP username you want us to create (we can pre-provision "hb-sig-reviewer").
- Do you require PGP-signed checksums or is HTTPS-hosted checksum text acceptable?

Tagging Soojin for HSM log export and Marissa for runbook extraction.

Thanks,

--
Michael Grant
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0187

From: Lisa Monroe <security-assurance@hearthbank.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: HearthBank SOC <soc@hearthbank.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Jul 2029 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ - Key management artifacts request

Michael — that timeline works for us. A few clarifications:

- Please provision SFTP user hb-sig-reviewer for the upload and we will provide the public SSH key to you by EOD.
- We prefer PGP-signed checksums if possible; if not, signed HTTPS is acceptable.
- For the HSM logs please make a short sampling manifest (which files correspond to which device/shift) so our reviewers can correlate.

If you can get the initial bundle by 17:00 PT today, the review team will start the sample validation tonight and provide any remediation questions Monday morning. Thank you.

Best,
Lisa

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Monroe <security-assurance@hearthbank.com>
